EMBERFALLReturn to game

Kingdoms at War

Build a village in a mountain valley. Grow your economy, shape its defenses and lead an army whose composition and deployment decide the battle.

Build your kingdom

Upgrade your Town Hall, resource buildings, Barracks, Camps, defenses and walls. Unlock new land across the bridge and strengthen your village with each level. Buildings and champions gain new architectural details, armor and equipment as they progress.

Lead your army

Train distinct troop types, unlock heroes and combine ranged fighters, frontline units, healers and flying creatures. Scout enemy defenses before deploying. Raiding resource stores and the Town Hall captures their supplies; surviving reserves return home.

Friends, clans and rivals

On a connected game server, your permanent Player ID helps friends find you. Join a clan, donate troops and take part in clan wars. Early matchmaking uses nearby Town Hall levels; from 1,000 trophies it follows trophy ranges. Suitable AI villages fill in when no player opponent is available.

Your progress

Collect production, clear obstacles and claim weekly Gem Boxes. Spend Gems on Shields or finish ongoing work. Account sign-in and purchases depend on the services enabled by your game server. The standalone preview saves your village on this device.
